apiVersion: fishyume/v2
name: host-agent-golden-path
defaults:
  agent:
    driver: codex
    target: local
execution:
  maxConcurrency: 1
nodes:
  plan:
    type: agent
    task: "Create a bounded implementation plan and return it as the node summary."
    context:
      projectInstructions: [AGENTS.md]
      dependencies: []
  approve:
    type: approval
    dependsOn: [plan]
    prompt: "Approve the implementation plan?"
  implement:
    type: agent
    dependsOn: [approve]
    when:
      node: approve
      field: result.decision
      equals: approved
    task: "Implement the approved plan, run focused checks, and summarize the result."
    context:
      projectInstructions: [AGENTS.md]
      dependencies: [plan]

implement.reason: Existing project constraint selected by the Host
